GR_IMPOSED_FORM_CHANGE_SYSTEM_SHOCK.rule: A form change imposed on another forces a System Shock survival roll.
GR_IMPOSED_FORM_CHANGE_SYSTEM_SHOCK.counter_example_tested: spell_polymorph_self — declines to invoke; confirms the rule is about imposition, not form change

GR_SELF_FORM_CHANGE_NO_SHOCK.rule: A self-initiated or innate form change does not force System Shock.
established_by: PHB POLYMORPH SELF ('No system shock check is required')
PHB SHAPE CHANGE ('No system shock is incurred')
GR_SELF_FORM_CHANGE_NO_SHOCK.counter_example_tested: spell_polymorph_other — does invoke; confirms the boundary

GR_HELPLESS_TARGET_AUTOHIT.rule: Paralyzed, held, sleeping or wholly immobile targets are struck automatically, take maximum damage, and gain no Dexterity benefit.
established_by: DMG p.70 Special Types Of Attacks
GR_HELPLESS_TARGET_AUTOHIT.counter_example_tested: naturally sleeping targets — routed to the assassination table instead; confirms the rule covers magical immobilisation
